summary: Ainos, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase its at-the-market (ATM) offering capacity under an existing Sales Agreement with H.C. Wainwright Co. The company upsized the aggregate offering price of common stock by $1,346,165, having already sold $2,714,728.20 under the agreement. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown amendment, not a transformative event. No special-situation characteristics such as acquisition, restructuring or activist campaign are present. The filing updates eligibility under General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3, capping sales to one-third of public float. No premium, board recommendation, price per share, or closing timeline is stated.
